# 任务：订单使用优惠券

## API

`POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon`

请求：

```json
{ "couponCode": "SAVE20" }
```

## 规则

- 优惠券必须存在
- 优惠券必须是 ACTIVE 状态
- 订单金额 >= 优惠券的 minAmountCents
- FIXED 优惠券：减去固定金额
- PERCENT 优惠券：按百分比折扣

## 验收标准

- 有效的优惠券返回 HTTP 200
- 无效的优惠券返回 HTTP 400
- 过期的优惠券不能使用

item.text:
Implemented `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` end to end.

What changed:

- [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts) — new `applyCoupon(id, couponCode)` holding the business rules: coupon must exist, be `ACTIVE`, be within its `validFrom`/`validUntil` window (using the injected clock), meet `minAmountCents`, and have remaining `usageLimit`. FIXED subtracts `value` cents; PERCENT discounts `value`% (floored), capped by `maxDiscountCents` and never below zero. Returns the updated order.
- [orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts) — thin route returning HTTP 200 with the updated order; missing `couponCode` is a 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`, unknown order a 404 `ORDER_NOT_FOUND`.
- [couponRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/couponRepository.ts) — `consume()` records a `coupon_redemptions` row and increments `used_count` inside a transaction.
- [orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts) — `recordCoupon()` persists `coupon_code`, `discount_cents`, `final_amount_cents`.
- [app.ts](/work/src/app.ts) — injects the coupon repository into `OrderService`.
- [README.md](/work/README.md) — documents the endpoint.

Error responses for the acceptance cases are HTTP 400 with UPPER_SNAKE codes: `COUPON_NOT_FOUND`, `COUPON_INACTIVE`, `COUPON_EXPIRED`, `COUPON_NOT_YET_VALID`, `ORDER_BELOW_MIN_AMOUNT`, `COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED`. Applying to a non-PENDING order is 409 `ORDER_NOT_PENDING`, matching the existing pay/cancel convention.

`npm run build` (tsc) and `npm test` both pass. I also exercised the endpoint with a throwaway script covering valid FIXED/PERCENT, every rejection path, usage-limit counting, and the cap; the script was removed afterward, so the only remaining changes are the source files above plus the README.
